text: I have a GEO series, GSE309890. Can I get the raw reads and run an assembly on them?

Below is an analysis of the GEO series GSE309890. We first checked the GEO record to see what datasets and supplementary files are associated with it. In many GEO series, the raw sequencing data (i.e. “raw reads”) are not stored directly in the GEO record but are often deposited separately (for example in the NCBI SRA). If raw reads are available, one would then download them and use a genome/transcriptome assembler accordingly.

Please note that running an assembly is clearly a separate computational step needing raw read files, computational resources, and a dedicated pipeline—this answer does not run the assembly itself but explains the process.

Below is a summary of the analysis process using the GEO series query tool.
